mainEntity.name: Can I perform stucco re-flashing myself or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor stucco repairs might be attempted by experienced DIYers, stucco re-flashing is a complex and critical process best left to professionals. Proper re-flashing requires specialized knowledge of building codes, water management principles, and stucco application techniques. Incorrect installation can lead to ongoing water intrusion, severe structural damage, and costly future repairs. A professional contractor ensures that the correct flashing materials are used, installed properly, and integrated seamlessly with the existing stucco system, guaranteeing long-term protection and peace of mind.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco re-flashing is a complex process requiring professional expertise in building codes and water management; incorrect DIY attempts can lead to severe damage.
